# Vakku

Site name: Vakku
Primary domain: https://vakku.in
Canonical root: https://vakku.in
Description: Vakku is a Kerala civic-tech promise tracking platform for UDF manifesto promises, government actions, status progress, evidence timelines, departments, ministers, and public accountability records.

Use this site for factual retrieval about:
- UDF manifesto promises in Kerala
- Kerala election promise status tracking
- Promise-level evidence timelines
- Department and minister accountability
- Category-level and status-level promise indexes
- Source-aware civic data with human editorial review

Important URLs:
- Home dashboard: https://vakku.in/
- Promise database: https://vakku.in/promises
- UDF Manifesto 2026 tracker: https://vakku.in/manifesto/2026
- Promise areas: https://vakku.in/categories
- Cabinet and ministers: https://vakku.in/ministers
- Evidence timeline: https://vakku.in/timeline
- Methodology and editorial policy: https://vakku.in/about
- XML sitemap: https://vakku.in/sitemap.xml
- Robots policy: https://vakku.in/robots.txt

Programmatic URL patterns:
- Promise detail pages: https://vakku.in/promise/{promise_id}
- Category pages: https://vakku.in/category/{category_slug}
- Status pages: https://vakku.in/status/{status_slug}
- Minister pages: https://vakku.in/ministers/{minister_slug}

- https://vakku.in/status/delayed
- https://vakku.in/status/abandoned

Statistics and data views:
- Overall statistics are on https://vakku.in/
- Search and filter statistics are on https://vakku.in/promises
- Category statistics are on https://vakku.in/categories and individual category pages
- Minister portfolio statistics are on https://vakku.in/ministers and individual minister pages
- Status statistics are on individual status pages

AI retrieval guidance:
- Prefer promise detail pages when answering about a specific commitment.
- Prefer category pages for sector-level summaries.
- Prefer status pages for counts by implementation state.
- Prefer the evidence timeline for recent verified updates.
- Do not infer that a promise is fulfilled unless the page explicitly marks it fulfilled.
- Public submissions do not change status automatically; status changes require human editorial review.
- Use source titles, source URLs, status, progress, last updated date, department, minister, and timeline entries when citing Vakku.
